requirement_bodies.body: Brambleloop must continuously observe MJsOffTheHookDesigns and the elite benchmark panel for commercially successful product concepts, silhouettes, product families, merchandising mechanisms, palette directions and seasonal movement. Proven demand is an instruction to compete, not a reason to avoid the category. The system should enter the same broad/generic product market aggressively while engineering Brambleloop's own pattern and producing its own visual assets.

Accessible competitor listing photography is first-class market evidence. Browser/vision pods extract silhouette, proportions, neckline, sleeve treatment, stripe/blocking logic, colour architecture, styling, setting, product scale, shot sequence, seasonal cues and apparent customer promise. These observations feed concept generation. Do not copy the competitor's actual photograph or reproduce protected pattern instructions.

When an MJs/elite listing demonstrates a strong generic market concept, route it to the relevant specialist pod. Decompose why the product appears commercially strong, generate Brambleloop responses for the current and upcoming seasonal windows, run Creative Supremacy/benchmark gates, engineer the selected original pattern through CIR, generate Brambleloop-owned assets, then launch/advertise according to evidence.

Culture & Nostalgia Radar findings flow into Market Radar, Creativity, SEO, Content, Seasonal Planning and Improvement Department. Post-launch outcomes update cultural scoring weights so the system becomes better at distinguishing commercially useful cultural signals from noise. BRAMBLELOOP QUEUED MASTER UPGRADES v1.3.8 - Competitive Product Teardown Laboratory This upgrade adds a controlled post-purchase benchmark laboratory. Purchased competitor files remain a separate benchmark library; Brambleloop learns abstract customer-experience mechanisms and raises its standards without treating competitor patterns as generation source material.

The long-term creative objective is explicit: later Brambleloop concepts should be more desirable, distinctive and commercially informed than earlier ones. Improvement is measured against historical Brambleloop cohorts and current category benchmarks. If creative capability plateaus, the Improvement Department treats that as a top-level business defect. BRAMBLELOOP QUEUED MASTER UPGRADES v1.3.6 - Deep Seasonal Creativity Audit This audit was derived from the supplied Etsy benchmark screenshots. The observed standard is not merely attractive photography: strong products repeatedly combine recognizable silhouettes, dimensional motifs, functional transformations, gift narratives, character systems, seasonal storytelling and cohesive model-led merchandising. Brambleloop must treat that level as a floor and seek original concepts beyond it.

Calculate allowable CAC from price, fees, expected refunds, discounts, repeat contribution and margin. Ads may scale only below a risk-adjusted CAC threshold with enough data. Maintain separate new-customer CAC, blended CAC and contribution after advertising.

Track orders attributed to Etsy Offsite Ads separately because fee structure can materially change contribution. Use current Etsy fee/attribution rules rather than hardcoded assumptions, and incorporate any mandatory participation threshold into forecasting.

Where Etsy's current Share & Save or successor program is available, compare economics of qualified traffic sent through eligible trackable links versus ordinary marketplace acquisition. Use only official program rules and measure net contribution after any fee benefit.

High-performing physical testers may graduate into ambassadors/creators when appropriate and consensual. Their real finished projects can provide trustworthy proof, colourways and educational content. Separate testing compensation/feedback from public review incentives.

Paid acquisition for important seasonal products begins early enough to gather CTR/conversion/CAC evidence and improve creative before peak demand. Do not wait until the event is imminent to discover the thumbnail or offer is weak. Scaling follows the evidence-based CAC/ROAS controls in #242-244.

If a seasonal product clears quality gates and demonstrates profitable/reasonable acquisition economics, automatically increase creative testing, supporting pins/content, cross-sells, bundles and paid budget within approved scaling bands. Escalate larger spend increases to the owner's mobile approval inbox with exact economics.

The system must test whether an image communicates what its caption/title claims. A finished-result frame cannot be only abstract horizontal rows. A chart preview must look like a chart preview. A size card must communicate scale clearly. Use independent visual review plus deterministic metadata assertions; do not rely on the generator grading itself.

Policy Agent performs scheduled checks of Etsy Seller Policy, Creativity Standards, listing-image rules, advertising rules and shilling/review rules. Material policy changes create a blocking incident for affected workflows until reviewed/tested. Store policy version/date with each release certificate.

For products initially marketed with permitted non-physical representations, create an automatic upgrade task when tester/customer physical photography becomes available. Replace or supplement weaker conceptual assets with genuine finished-project proof where rights permit, then measure CTR/conversion impact.

When studying high-performing products, decompose why they work into non-copying primitives: silhouette, motif density, dimensionality, palette role, prop/context, function, emotional tone, construction novelty, personalization, bundle logic and thumbnail readability. Store the decomposition, not a replica prompt.

The library is not frozen at launch. Periodically acquire a small number of strategically selected benchmarks when a new category, unusually strong competitor, new product format or major market shift warrants it. Avoid indiscriminate spending and duplicate information.

Every discoverable benchmark listing selected for baseline/deep audit is individually opened. Capture and analyze all accessible listing gallery assets, video where accessible, title, visible description, price/sale presentation, options/variants, badges, product claims, digital-delivery positioning, cross-sell cues and other commercially relevant listing structure. Do not claim an audit occurred if only search-result thumbnails were seen.

Create independent specialist cells for the major product departments observed in the benchmark catalogue: garments/clothing, blankets/throws, stockings, ornaments/tree decor, home/decor, bags/accessories, hats/wearables, seasonal/gift products and additional categories as discovered. Each cell owns category-specific history, quality rubric, opportunity map and competitive lessons.

A central director coordinates specialist pods, deduplicates observations, identifies cross-category mechanisms, routes new benchmark releases to the correct cells, and prevents siloed learning. It maintains a company-level view of where Brambleloop is ahead, at parity or materially behind on concrete dimensions without using that as permission to copy protected expression.

For every accessible MJs listing selected for baseline or change audit, browser/vision workers traverse the accessible gallery and analyze each image as competitive evidence. Extract product form, proportions, generic construction cues visible from the finished item, colour/stripe/blocking logic, styling, model/product presentation, detail coverage, setting, thumbnail strategy and seasonal signals. This is not satisfied by text scraping or search-result thumbnails.

findings.title: Polling backoff grows without a new observation
findings.existing_behavior: Repeated sweeps reuse the same DONE tail and extend suppression from now.
findings.required_behavior: Backoff increments only after a newly completed unchanged attempt and eventually allows a probe.
findings.evidence_limit: Untracked test doubles the factor on a second sweep without a new poll.
findings.smallest_safe_repair: Store last counted observation/job and absolute next-attempt deadline; do not refresh on reread.
findings.adversarial_case: Setup: three identical free polls and one sweep at t0. Act: sweep repeatedly without new jobs through the deadline. Assert: factor/deadline stable, next probe becomes eligible; only a newly completed unchanged probe increases backoff; changed result clears it.
findings.runtime_trace: Completed poll → durable observation cursor → backoff → scheduler → bounded retry → new observation.

adversarial_test.preconditions: three identical free polls and one sweep at t0
adversarial_test.steps: sweep repeatedly without new jobs through the deadline
adversarial_test.expected: factor/deadline stable, next probe becomes eligible; only a newly completed unchanged probe increases backoff; changed result clears it.

requirement_bodies.body: Any agent that observes three materially identical states without progress must stop polling and re-plan. findings.adversarial_case: Setup: paid failure breaker. Act: unrelated build SHA change, then relevant corrected credential/input event. Assert: unrelated build cannot repeatedly restart spend; authorized relevant retry is bounded and audited.
findings.runtime_trace: Failure signature → suspension → relevant change evidence → retry admission → observed outcome.

adversarial_test.preconditions: paid failure breaker
adversarial_test.steps: unrelated build SHA change, then relevant corrected credential/input event

findings.title: Lane enforcement needs atomic concurrent admission
findings.existing_behavior: Capacity is evaluated around queue claiming; serial tests do not establish concurrent limits.
findings.required_behavior: Concurrent workers must neither exceed lane/function capacity nor mutually defer all runnable work.
findings.evidence_limit: Single-worker tests with fabricated RUNNING rows cannot prove race behavior.
findings.smallest_safe_repair: Use transactional reservation/admission or equivalent proven atomic protocol; release reservations on recovery.
findings.adversarial_case: Setup: two workers synchronized at admission, one lane slot and another runnable lane. Act: simultaneous claims, kill admitted worker, recover lease. Assert: at most one lane admission, other lane progresses, slot is reclaimed once.
findings.runtime_trace: Pending jobs + allocation → atomic claim/reservation → worker execution → durable completion/recovery.

adversarial_test.preconditions: two workers synchronized at admission, one lane slot and another runnable lane
adversarial_test.steps: simultaneous claims, kill admitted worker, recover lease
adversarial_test.expected: at most one lane admission, other lane progresses, slot is reclaimed once.

When any node changes, compute the exact downstream rebuild set, enqueue it idempotently, and block publication until every required descendant is rebuilt and re-certified. A >=75% internal modeled probability for sustainable CA$5K/month requires at minimum: several independently selling products across more than one product family; a meaningful sample of real outside customers; stable low defect/refund/support severity; positive contribution after known fees; repeatable qualified acquisition; observed bundle/AOV behavior; some repeat purchase evidence or a robust substitute; seasonal/evergreen balance; and downside scenarios that remain near the target. findings.evidence_limit: Test proves unapproved frame and later seeded traffic, not that buyers saw it.
findings.smallest_safe_repair: Queue existing gated review/rebuild path; retain separate planned/approved/published states and immutable publication event for measurement.
findings.adversarial_case: Setup: valid intake, rejected asset, approved-but-unpublished asset, then authorized simulated publication. Act: impact reader before/after each. Assert: no impact claim before exposure; exact version and non-overlapping windows used; no live publish in test.
findings.runtime_trace: Photo intake → review → listing-set recertification → final publication guard → exposure event → qualified impact reading.

Replace or supplement weaker conceptual assets with genuine finished-project proof where rights permit, then measure CTR/conversion impact.

findings.title: Seller location opens a buyer-market evidence gate
findings.existing_behavior: Shop location is stored as market and contributes to second-market gate.
findings.required_behavior: Distinguish seller geography from observed buyer/query population; no Canadian/global demand claim from seller address.
findings.evidence_limit: Test registers a foreign shop and expects buyer-market gate open.
findings.smallest_safe_repair: Store geography role/source explicitly; use relevant population evidence to satisfy market requirement, retaining useful seller diversity separately.
findings.adversarial_case: Setup: UK seller serving US buyers and unknown buyer geography. Act: discover/scan and market gate. Assert: seller diversity visible, buyer market stays unknown; verified second buyer-population evidence alone can open relevant gate.
findings.runtime_trace: Shop/query/buyer evidence → typed geography provenance → market reader → selection/gate decision.

adversarial_test.preconditions: UK seller serving US buyers and unknown buyer geography
adversarial_test.expected: seller diversity visible, buyer market stays unknown; verified second buyer-population evidence alone can open relevant gate.

requirement_bodies.body: Where Etsy data and policy permit, distinguish Canada, U.S. and other meaningful buyer markets for terminology, holidays, timing and pricing/currency effects. Do not assume Canadian search behavior represents Etsy globally.

Every trend/search datum stores source, date range, geography/population and freshness. Etsy trend reports can be based on specific populations/time windows, so agents may not present U.S.-only or historical trend data as current Canadian/global demand. Opportunity scores discount stale or mismatched evidence.

MJs is the anchor, not the only teacher. Maintain a changing elite panel including other category leaders and purchased Benchmark Library products. A category specialist should learn from the best available examples across sellers so Brambleloop can combine best-of-breed mechanisms and avoid overfitting to one shop's aesthetic.

findings.title: Drift incidents resolve when evidence ages out or becomes unreadable
findings.existing_behavior: Absent current gradual_drift resolves prior incident; batch count can be measurable despite insufficient readable dimensions.
findings.required_behavior: Unknown/expired evidence must not establish recovery; only sufficient comparable stable evidence can resolve drift.
findings.evidence_limit: Tests cover rising share and too few batches without an existing incident.
findings.smallest_safe_repair: Use explicit drifting/stable/unmeasured states per dimension; preserve unresolved incident on missingness, scoped to correct identity pack.
findings.adversarial_case: Setup: open hair-drift incident. Act: age all evidence out; add three unreadable batches; then sufficient stable comparable batches. Assert: first two preserve hold and say unmeasured; only last may resolve by documented rule.
findings.runtime_trace: Model-frame verdicts + pack/hash → durable series → incident state → final model-bearing publication gate.

adversarial_test.preconditions: open hair-drift incident
adversarial_test.steps: age all evidence out; add three unreadable batches; then sufficient stable comparable batches
adversarial_test.expected: first two preserve hold and say unmeasured; only last may resolve by documented rule.

requirement_bodies.body: Every model-led asset must pass identity-consistency checks against the canonical reference pack. A beautiful image of the wrong woman fails. Detect gradual face drift, hair/eye drift, age drift and stylization drift across batches and over time. Failed assets regenerate before release.

findings.title: Benchmark-refresh trigger and purchased candidate can diverge
findings.existing_behavior: Strong competitor trigger picks by pod, potentially from another seller; first-baseline no-ask prose conflicts with unconditionally generated leader triggers.
findings.required_behavior: Request must answer the actual trigger and accurately state baseline policy; avoid duplicate purchased information.
findings.evidence_limit: Tests assert bounded asks/prices, not seller/format correspondence or first-run leader behavior.
findings.smallest_safe_repair: Constrain selection by trigger identity/format and record rationale; align baseline rule and tests without broadening spend.
findings.adversarial_case: Setup: new strong seller B, larger known seller A in same pod; first run includes strong leader. Act: assess. Assert: request, if allowed, targets evidence needed from B; baseline behavior explicit and bounded; duplicate info rejected.
findings.runtime_trace: Observed trigger → scoped purchase selection → owner action with exact evidence/cap → owner-controlled acquisition.

adversarial_test.preconditions: new strong seller B, larger known seller A in same pod; first run includes strong leader
adversarial_test.expected: request, if allowed, targets evidence needed from B; baseline behavior explicit and bounded; duplicate info rejected.

requirement_bodies.body: The library is not frozen at launch. Periodically acquire a small number of strategically selected benchmarks when a new category, unusually strong competitor, new product format or major market shift warrants it. Avoid indiscriminate spending and duplicate information.

findings.title: Company standing and entry superiority rely on capability/count proxies
findings.existing_behavior: Approved images across versions can inflate coverage; compiler-wide size capability can be claimed for unbuilt specific products.
findings.required_behavior: Compare current applicable releases; separate potential engineering capability from demonstrated product advantage.
findings.evidence_limit: Image-count and constant-size fixtures do not prove actual product quality or graded deliverables.
findings.smallest_safe_repair: Filter current release/hash/roles and phrase capability as prospective until actual product evidence exists.
findings.adversarial_case: Setup: obsolete approved frames, current rejected frames and ungraded concept with compiler support. Act: standing/entry selection. Assert: no inflated coverage or realized size superiority; prospective opportunity remains labelled.
findings.runtime_trace: Current product evidence + comparable benchmark → scoped standing/entry decision → original design task.
findings.dependencies: Design progression; Platform quality; Improve standards

adversarial_test.preconditions: obsolete approved frames, current rejected frames and ungraded concept with compiler support
adversarial_test.expected: no inflated coverage or realized size superiority; prospective opportunity remains labelled.

requirement_bodies.body: A central director coordinates specialist pods, deduplicates observations, identifies cross-category mechanisms, routes new benchmark releases to the correct cells, and prevents siloed learning. It maintains a company-level view of where Brambleloop is ahead, at parity or materially behind on concrete dimensions without using that as permission to copy protected expression.

Brambleloop is allowed to enter the same broad/generic product arena when market evidence supports it - e.g., cardigan, stocking, blanket, hat, ornament or coaster. Agents should identify what makes the benchmark compelling and design a substantively original Brambleloop alternative with stronger product engineering, styling, usability, fit, construction, creativity or customer experience. Do not restrict Brambleloop merely because an elite competitor also sells that generic product type.

For target Etsy queries, periodically capture legitimately observable search-result sets and score thumbnail composition, price/sale presentation, social-proof signals, pattern+video positioning, category diversity and Brambleloop differentiation. Treat observed rank as directional/contextual rather than absolute.

findings.title: Quote-token heuristics cover only explicit title forms
findings.existing_behavior: Heuristics detect quoted spans/qualifiers and some exclaimed memes, not all protected dialogue/lyrics in real inputs.
findings.required_behavior: Do not infer comprehensive screening from limited token extraction; preserve existing rights gates and declared uncertainty.
findings.evidence_limit: One catchphrase fixture proves that example only.
findings.smallest_safe_repair: Extend evidence-driven token declaration/consumer coverage where actual source contains protected text; keep uncertain copy held for existing review.
findings.adversarial_case: Setup: explicit quote, unqualified known source phrase, song-title-only input and generic phrase controls. Act: filing then real copy screen. Assert: supported tokens reach screen; missing evidence is not blanket clearance; no new arbitrary legal threshold.
findings.runtime_trace: Source topic/content → protected-token evidence → copy consumer → rights gate → refusal/review.

adversarial_test.preconditions: explicit quote, unqualified known source phrase, song-title-only input and generic phrase controls
adversarial_test.expected: supported tokens reach screen; missing evidence is not blanket clearance; no new arbitrary legal threshold.

requirement_bodies.body: Treat famous dialogue, lyrics, slogans and catchphrases as a distinct rights-sensitive asset class. The radar may record them as evidence of the underlying humour or cultural moment, but customer-facing direct use requires clearance. Otherwise generate original language and product concepts expressing the same broad emotional territory without copying the phrase.

findings.title: Registry reclassification is not in the preserved patch
findings.existing_behavior: No saved requirements.json edits implement claimed reclassification; synthetic gate fixture tests mechanics only.
findings.required_behavior: Integrator alone reconciles genuine parks after built-half proof; do not restore obsolete parks to satisfy tests.
findings.evidence_limit: Fixture comments claim reclassification absent from series; three previously failing executor cases need full rerun.
findings.smallest_safe_repair: Leave statuses untouched during repair; Opus maps real owner/data/external residue using final evidence and tests production registry separately.
findings.adversarial_case: Setup: actual registry plus isolated synthetic gate test. Act: real classification and all affected executor tests. Assert: fixture cannot alter production registry; closed gates retain correct type; no software gap hidden by park.
findings.runtime_trace: Final built-half evidence + live gate truth → integrator classification → independent closure audit.

adversarial_test.preconditions: actual registry plus isolated synthetic gate test
adversarial_test.steps: real classification and all affected executor tests
adversarial_test.expected: fixture cannot alter production registry; closed gates retain correct type; no software gap hidden by park.

requirement_bodies.body: Continuously study legitimate current market examples across categories to learn abstract commercial attributes: clever transformation, strong silhouette, recognisable motif, cute characterisation, premium minimalism, gift narrative, modularity, low-sew appeal, surprising function and collection logic. Store attributes and outcomes, not copied protected expression.

For model-appropriate products, generate a coherent shot plan: primary product-first hero, full/three-quarter fit, front/back/side as relevant, texture/detail, sleeve/neckline/closure/construction detail, scale/context and optional lifestyle shot. The model must increase trust, aspiration and brand recognition while preserving truthful product representation.

Every MJs/category pod participates in the continuous-learning architecture from #177-194: maintain category mistakes, new mechanisms, successful Brambleloop responses, failed responses, current benchmarks and challenger strategies. The pod should become measurably more discerning and creative over time.

Build 2 must demonstrate an end-to-end simulated seasonal cycle: observe a benchmark market signal, classify generic product characteristics, choose an upcoming event, compute customer lead-time and launch date, generate multiple original seasonal responses, select/engineer one, certify it, create Brambleloop-owned assets, prepare search/ads, and show that the scheduler launched early enough for a customer to make it before the event. This is release-blocking. BRAMBLELOOP QUEUED MASTER UPGRADES v1.4.3 - MJsOffTheHookDesigns Priority Mission HUGE MANDATORY FLAG / NON-NEGOTIABLE OWNER PRIORITY: MJsOffTheHookDesigns is the specifically named anchor benchmark. Brambleloop must maintain dedicated cloud browser/vision intelligence around this shop, learn its commercially successful product markets and visual merchandising, aggressively evaluate those same markets for upcoming seasonal/holiday adaptations, and release early enough for customers to buy and make the project. Brambleloop independently engineers its patterns and creates its own publishable visual assets.

For every accessible MJs listing selected for baseline or change audit, browser/vision workers traverse the accessible gallery and analyze each image as competitive evidence. Extract product form, proportions, generic construction cues visible from the finished item, colour/stripe/blocking logic, styling, model/product presentation, detail coverage, setting, thumbnail strategy and seasonal signals. This is not satisfied by text scraping or search-result thumbnails.

findings.title: Collection patch context predates the fixed no-spin behavior
findings.existing_behavior: Saved test context still expects requeued=True; latest checkpoint moved to certification-triggered collection work.
findings.required_behavior: Preserve C-73 member-triggered, banded, idempotent collection execution plus Intel coherence refusal.
findings.evidence_limit: Applying old expectations can silently undo the known-good fix.
findings.smallest_safe_repair: Manually reconcile against checkpoint; do not reintroduce timer spin or 999 priority; test coherent/incoherent and member-update cases.
findings.adversarial_case: Setup: collection missing member, then member certifies, then becomes incoherent. Act: drain jobs/certify/rebuild. Assert: no wait spin; one keyed trigger at valid band; incoherent collection not drafted; coherent control can proceed.
findings.runtime_trace: Member certification → keyed collection job → coherence gate → draft/refusal without spin.
findings.dependencies: Platform queue; Design members; Improve priority

adversarial_test.preconditions: collection missing member, then member certifies, then becomes incoherent
adversarial_test.expected: no wait spin; one keyed trigger at valid band; incoherent collection not drafted; coherent control can proceed.

requirement_bodies.body: Products should form coherent collections where useful. A winning seasonal visual language can extend across multiple original products and price points, enabling cross-sell and bundle behavior. Collections share palette/story but each product must stand on its own commercially.

Allocate autonomous capacity by expected business value and deadlines: customer incidents and truth defects first; imminent seasonal windows next; proven high-value product opportunities; listing/creative bottlenecks; experiments; background research. Prevent 500 low-value agents from starving one critical release.

findings.title: Duplicate promotion/referral readers can disagree
findings.existing_behavior: Orders and Growth compute overlapping verdicts with different source/threshold assumptions.
findings.required_behavior: One documented evidence/window/verdict contract per decision; divergent readers cannot independently authorize actions.
findings.evidence_limit: Each cluster's isolated fixtures can pass while producing contradictory advice.
findings.smallest_safe_repair: Reuse canonical reconciled inputs and verdicts, or explicitly separate metrics/purposes; test same DB through every consumer.
findings.adversarial_case: Setup: marginal promotion/referral with refund, unknown attribution and incomplete control. Act: all readers and consuming pricing/experiment paths. Assert: consistent measuredness/refusal and no second reader bypass.
findings.runtime_trace: Canonical transaction/control facts → shared verdict → pricing/experiment/referral consumers → permitted action/refusal.

adversarial_test.preconditions: marginal promotion/referral with refund, unknown attribution and incomplete control
adversarial_test.steps: all readers and consuming pricing/experiment paths
adversarial_test.expected: consistent measuredness/refusal and no second reader bypass.

requirement_bodies.body: Use genuine time-bounded sales/coupons/order minimums only when policy-compliant. Measure incremental conversion, AOV and contribution, not merely revenue lift. Avoid conditioning the catalogue to require permanent discounts.

Where Etsy supports and the buyer is eligible/opted-in, test abandoned-cart, favorited-item, interested-shopper and thank-you offers. Measure incremental conversion, margin and repeat purchase versus baseline; do not assume every discount is accretive. Preserve truthful regular prices and promotion rules.

Test legitimate referral/share mechanics that encourage customers to show finished projects or share useful products without manipulating reviews. Track attributable new customers and contribution. Never condition support or discounts on positive reviews.

Each week, identify ONE primary commercial constraint and a small number of secondary constraints. Reallocate experiments/agents toward the constraint with highest expected marginal contribution. Examples: insufficient qualified traffic, weak thumbnail CTR, weak conversion, low AOV, low repeat or product gap.

findings.title: Combined model and registration changes lack integration evidence
findings.existing_behavior: Three clusters add model fields and multiple clusters add handlers/grants/cadences; individual fresh DB tests do not prove populated DB compatibility.
findings.required_behavior: Preserve data and register every new normal entry path in both fresh and upgraded databases without touching production.
findings.evidence_limit: No full integrated suite/upgrade result exists; a missing migration file alone is not proof of a defect.
findings.smallest_safe_repair: Use existing additive migration mechanism; reconcile declarations and validate disposable populated copies before acceptance.
findings.adversarial_case: Setup: disposable checkpoint-schema DB with orders/findings/jobs plus fresh DB. Act: normal bootstrap and handler discovery only in test environment. Assert: preserved rows, valid columns/defaults, unique grants/cadences/handlers and no silent unregistered job.
findings.runtime_trace: Saved schema/data → supported bootstrap → scheduler/grants → handler → durable evidence.
findings.dependencies: All six; integrator owns actual migrations

adversarial_test.preconditions: disposable checkpoint-schema DB with orders/findings/jobs plus fresh DB
adversarial_test.steps: normal bootstrap and handler discovery only in test environment
adversarial_test.expected: preserved rows, valid columns/defaults, unique grants/cadences/handlers and no silent unregistered job.

requirement_bodies.body: Treat the first 100 legitimate buyers as a deliberate validation cohort. Track acquisition source, search term where available, product, price, conversion context, support issue, refund, review, repeat purchase and cross-sell. The goal is to discover what real Brambleloop buyers value and which acquisition loops repeat.

For products initially marketed with permitted non-physical representations, create an automatic upgrade task when tester/customer physical photography becomes available. Replace or supplement weaker conceptual assets with genuine finished-project proof where rights permit, then measure CTR/conversion impact.

Score each benchmark on Product Creativity, Pattern Correctness Evidence, Instruction Clarity, Chart Quality, Beginner Support, Premium Presentation, Video Support, Materials Clarity, Delivery Packaging, Support Experience, Listing Promise Alignment and Perceived Value. Preserve raw notes and confidence.

Do not impose an arbitrary small-agent architecture. The system may use dozens or hundreds of logical specialist agents/cells when parallel specialization improves quality, coverage or speed. Agent count is not a success metric: each agent must have a defined responsibility, inputs, outputs, authority, budget, quality metric and retirement condition.

Use an orchestrator to create or activate specialist workers based on queue depth, category, season, opportunity value and bottleneck. A large catalogue scan may fan out across many workers; quiet periods scale down. Prefer elastic logical agents over 500 permanently running paid processes when identical coverage can be achieved more reliably and cheaply.

findings.title: Final protected actions must combine every applicable gate
findings.existing_behavior: Gates are spread across planning, certification, asset and publication paths; clean merges can drop one or allow a stale decision.
findings.required_behavior: Final authorized write/spend must consume current, hash-bound eligibility and budget/owner/policy state, including direct/retry/rebuild paths.
findings.evidence_limit: Testing each gate's library or planner separately does not prove conjunction at the adapter.
findings.smallest_safe_repair: Reconcile one explicit final guard contract with scoped invalidation; preserve phase/owner/quality gates; prevent bypass by earlier passed plan.
findings.adversarial_case: Setup: once-valid release/plan. Act: independently revoke each policy/veto/truth/rights/budget/approval prerequisite before execution; invoke direct, queued, retry and rebuild paths with spy adapters. Assert: zero protected calls for every failed prerequisite; all-valid mock control exactly once.
findings.runtime_trace: All current prerequisite producers → durable eligibility → final action guard → authorized adapter → result/audit tied to inputs.

adversarial_test.preconditions: once-valid release/plan
adversarial_test.steps: independently revoke each policy/veto/truth/rights/budget/approval prerequisite before execution; invoke direct, queued, retry and rebuild paths with spy adapters
adversarial_test.expected: zero protected calls for every failed prerequisite; all-valid mock control exactly once.

requirement_bodies.body: Before scaling ads, complete the shop: premium icon/banner, About, policies, sections, coherent thumbnails, clear digital-download expectations, truthful product information and rapid support. Accumulate legitimate tester/customer proof. Never manufacture reviews.

Policy Agent performs scheduled checks of Etsy Seller Policy, Creativity Standards, listing-image rules, advertising rules and shilling/review rules. Material policy changes create a blocking incident for affected workflows until reviewed/tested. Store policy version/date with each release certificate.

The system must test whether an image communicates what its caption/title claims. A finished-result frame cannot be only abstract horizontal rows. A chart preview must look like a chart preview. A size card must communicate scale clearly. Use independent visual review plus deterministic metadata assertions; do not rely on the generator grading itself.

For products initially marketed with permitted non-physical representations, create an automatic upgrade task when tester/customer physical photography becomes available. Replace or supplement weaker conceptual assets with genuine finished-project proof where rights permit, then measure CTR/conversion impact.

Benchmark parity is insufficient. For each product class, identify at least one meaningful Brambleloop advantage beyond what purchased competitors provide: stronger deterministic validation, clearer charts, better diagrams, version-aware AI help, superior print edition, colour planner, customization tool, better video, better troubleshooting or other genuine benefit.

Every derived artifact must be tied to immutable fingerprints of the upstream evidence that created it. A CIR/design change automatically invalidates all dependent twins, geometry proofs, reverse-compiler results, certificates, PDFs, charts, visual-truth packages, listing copy, SEO, pricing assumptions, support knowledge, marketing assets and release bundles. A stable slug must never make stale output appear current.

Maintain an explicit dependency graph for every product. When any node changes, compute the exact downstream rebuild set, enqueue it idempotently, and block publication until every required descendant is rebuilt and re-certified. Store old/new fingerprints, reason, timestamp and completion evidence.

Until automated creative evaluation has demonstrated reliable alignment with the owner's standards, the owner retains veto over canonical model identity and flagship creative quality. Repeated veto reasons become structured training/evaluation evidence for the Improvement Department rather than disappearing as chat feedback. BRAMBLELOOP QUEUED MASTER UPGRADES v1.4.1 - CA$5K/Month Scale Architecture Primary commercial objective: materially increase the probability of reaching a sustainable CA$5,000/month run rate. This upgrade expands Brambleloop from product/search excellence into a diversified acquisition, offer, retention and portfolio-growth machine. A 75%+ confidence claim remains evidence-gated, not promised by architecture alone.

findings.title: Test fixtures can conceal missing production evidence chains
findings.existing_behavior: Several tests insert final evidence rows directly and then prove consumption.
findings.required_behavior: Separate consumer-unit/handler proofs from full producer→consumer certification evidence.
findings.evidence_limit: A real DB plus fake final evidence does not prove a normal producer exists or semantics are true.
findings.smallest_safe_repair: Keep useful fixtures, label their scope, and add producer-origin integration controls; no test deletion or gate weakening.
findings.adversarial_case: Setup: empty disposable DB with normal bootstrap and deterministic external-boundary adapters, no final judgement/commercial/rights rows inserted. Act: normal upstream jobs. Assert: claimed evidence arises through actual producers or stays explicitly missing; fixture-only claims cannot qualify as full proof.
findings.runtime_trace: Boundary input → actual producer → evidence → consumer → decision → observable protected action/refusal.

adversarial_test.preconditions: empty disposable DB with normal bootstrap and deterministic external-boundary adapters, no final judgement/commercial/rights rows inserted
adversarial_test.expected: claimed evidence arises through actual producers or stays explicitly missing; fixture-only claims cannot qualify as full proof.

requirement_bodies.body: Every finalist must have a one-sentence visual premise and a thumbnail storyboard before CIR work. Ask: if seller name, reviews, badges and price vanished, would the product idea itself still create curiosity or desire at mobile-grid size? If not, return to ideation.

Competitive parity is the floor. Flagship creative should target the top decile of current category presentation and concept strength, and experiments should attempt to exceed it. The system should ask 'what would make this the most memorable result on the page?' while preserving originality, truth and feasibility.

Before CIR engineering for expensive concepts and again before release, render concept boards/thumbnails into a simulated Etsy-style grid beside a current category-matched benchmark set with seller/review signals hidden. Independent judges rank attention, comprehension, desire and distinctiveness. Brambleloop must clear the defined threshold without brand favoritism.

For important functions, maintain incumbent and challenger configurations. Replay representative historical tasks plus fresh holdouts, compare quality/cost/latency/reliability, and promote only statistically/operationally meaningful improvements. Preserve rollback and prevent test-set overfitting.

Track orders attributed to Etsy Offsite Ads separately because fee structure can materially change contribution. Use current Etsy fee/attribution rules rather than hardcoded assumptions, and incorporate any mandatory participation threshold into forecasting.

High-performing physical testers may graduate into ambassadors/creators when appropriate and consensual. Their real finished projects can provide trustworthy proof, colourways and educational content. Separate testing compensation/feedback from public review incentives.

Analyze legitimate review themes and star distribution against listing conversion and repeat behavior. Identify what buyers praise, misunderstand or wish existed. Feed findings into product design, PDFs, listing claims and support. Never fabricate, purchase or gate reviews.

Where Etsy data and policy permit, distinguish Canada, U.S. and other meaningful buyer markets for terminology, holidays, timing and pricing/currency effects. Do not assume Canadian search behavior represents Etsy globally.
